data.title: 椎名真昼 · 商业街并肩同行的微热红晕·「被同学看到的话……会误会的……但我不讨厌」
data.description: 【冬日商业街红砖道·午后】放学后一起采购食材的路上。真昼裹着象牙白粗花呢大衣和红格子围巾，双手缩在袖口里悄悄拉住你的衣角。两人的指尖在冬日寒风中无意相触，她整张脸颊瞬间泛起诱人的绯红，慌乱地偏过头看地砖。
data.location: 冬日繁华商业街林荫道
data.action: 双手缩在袖口轻拉衣角，围巾半掩脸颊，害羞低头视线躲闪
data.lighting: 冬日清亮冷暖交织的阳光穿过枯枝
data.camera: medium shot, winter coat, scarf, holding sleeve, heavy blush
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina draws her hands into her ivory duffle-coat sleeves and quietly catches her companion's coat edge while they shop for groceries. Their fingertips touch, and she looks down with an immediate blush above the red-and-white plaid scarf. The medium view follows the red-brick sidewalk between bare street trees. Clear winter sunlight catches scarf fibers and coat toggles, with branch shadows crossing the paving beneath their close steps.
